rows.en: Target craft's damage status confirmed.
The Chief needs cover, it seems.
rows.notes: 'taishou' rendered 'Chief'; it is how Guld addresses the player/partner in these clips.

rows.en: At this rate, the target is in danger.
Chief, come in.
I never thought the Chief would go down.
Loss of target craft confirmed.
What is this feeling? Withdrawing!
Time to head back.
I'm not in the mood to fight.
As expected, Captain.
You've got decent skills, Captain.
Pretty good for someone so reckless.
Run while you still can.
Learn how far apart our skills are.
Stay out of my way.
Hey, how are you holding up?
Systems are green. We're good to go?
All right, let's go!
I won't lose.
Let's go! Are you with me?
Looking forward to drinks after this.
We'll be fine.
Leave the support to me. Focus on the fight.
Still the same coward, I see.
Oh, you're alive. Lucky bastard.
You were the one who was supposed to turn to dust.
Good work.
Well, time to head back.
That's it, then.
I'm counting on you next time too.
Both your machine and your skills seem decent.
All that's left is to settle this.
Come on, let's get back and have a drink.
Stay up here a bit longer?
rows.notes: Heard 'yamanai ka'; read as 'tobanai ka' or 'tomaranai ka'.

rows.en: I'm glad we can fly side by side.
You can't do it.
Turn back. You're only holding us back.
I hate babysitting, but...
rows.notes: Trails off: 'o-mori wa gomen da ga'.

rows.en: Watch what I can do.
Stay sharp out here.
Don't do anything reckless.
Now then, let's see what you can do.
Leave the support to me.
I'll cover you.
I'm going to rely on you.
I'll protect you.
Now then, time to have some fun.
What a waste.
I'm impressed you were tough enough not to die.
I'm surprised you made it back.
I'm heading back.
Looks like it's over.
Decent skill.
Not bad, keeping up with me.
Best of all, we got back safely.
I'm counting on you from here on too.
I exist to protect you.
I'm leaving my lucky charm with you until we meet again.
Let me buy you a drink tonight.
Let's settle the Project!
rows.notes: 'purojekuto' as transcribed; probably Project Super Nova.

rows.en: Hey, Isamu. How's it going?
You win, Isamu.
Looks like I win this time.
So close.
You were the one to turn to dust.
What?!
You're the one who started it! Dredging up the past now?!
rows.notes: Heard 'saki ni ashi o tsuita'; read as 'saki ni te o dashita'; 'netsu o suru' read as 'mushikaesu'.

rows.en: Because you walked out on your own seven years ago!
I got stuck with the bill 13 times!
rows.notes: Heard 'omorasareta'; read as 'ogorasareta'; could also be 'otosareta' (shot down).

rows.en: You're the one who broke my plane at the school festival, too!
Don't play dumb! What a piece of work you are!
You always smash everything that matters to me.
The things that matter to me!
Even back then, seven years ago, if it weren't for you... if only you...
That's right. It was me. I did it all.
And then I locked away my memories myself.
Did I lose that person in exchange for my true memories?
I'm broken. Am I going mad?
So you're unharmed.
